data.long_meaning: In Greek, Kalie means 'beautiful' or 'pure'. It is derived from the Greek word 'kalos', meaning 'beautiful' or 'handsome'. In the Bible, the name Kalos is given to a man who shows kindness and generosity to Paul and Barnabas. In Christian spirituality, the name represents purity of heart and soul. The name Kalie carries the meaning “Pure, Beautiful” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Kalie usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, beautiful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
